title: Continuous reaching across recording days
disposition_reason: A complete numerical artifact scorer is present for one exposed Indy day pair and 22,091 trailing-velocity endpoints. Exact prepared arrays remain operator-provisioned; the registered historical program runner and legacy scorer dependency are absent from the published source. The source-wide later-session/second-animal claim and matched investigation modes remain unfinished.

scientific_target.question: For the fixed Indy 2016-10-05 to 2016-10-06 development transfer, how accurately do allowed 20 ms electrode counts plus 60 seconds of labeled target-day calibration predict all later trailing-bin x/y finger velocities; and how does performance compare with fixed source-only, calibration-only and pooled decoders?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured trailing 20 ms finger velocity in m/s, x then y, at each assessment endpoint. This is continuous movement reconstruction from neural observations, not reproduction of a published score table.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Frozen conversion of independently recorded hand-tracker positions from the original RTT sessions; private target identity is fixed by the external-artifact scorer. Raw finger_pos uses cm and (z,-x,-y); the prepared packet coordinate convention, not an assumed raw-axis mapping, governs output.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete target-day assessment segment with 22,091 nested endpoint rows; a row is not an independent animal or recording session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One monkey, Indy, and one source-to-target day pair in the delivered scope. The archive has two animals, but Loco and other day pairs are not covered by this scorer.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective batch neural-to-kinematic prediction under fixed labeled calibration. Later assessment neural counts may be inspected; online forecasting and causal neural mechanisms cannot be inferred from this score.
exclusions: Longitudinal tracking of sorted individual neurons
Direct or viewer-mediated understanding inferred from programme/file scores

inputs: Source-day counts: 18,700 by 96 electrode channels, with 18,691 labeled velocity endpoints.
Target-day first 60 s calibration: 3,000 by 96 counts with 2,991 labeled velocity endpoints.
Target-free full-batch assessment: 22,100 by 96 counts, native clock edges and 22,091 public endpoint IDs. Counts aggregate all released sort slots, including residual unsorted events, in 20 ms bins.
Exact candidate-public source/calibration/assessment/manifest asset identities in external-artifact-v1/ASSETS.json; data bodies are not included in the source release.
forbidden_inputs: Assessment movement targets, saved reference predictions/metrics and outcome-dependent selection feedback.
Answer-bearing external source lookup or prior target access; public source availability must be recorded as exposure.
observation_contract.case_identity: Every integer case_id 3010 through 25100 exactly once; candidate_io.py sorts and joins IDs. velocity_m_s has exact shape [22091,2].
observation_contract.split: Delivered chronological Indy 2016-10-05 source segment, first 60 s of 2016-10-06 calibration and guarded later assessment. A source-wide evaluation must freeze additional whole later sessions within each animal before fitting, retain temporal guards covering preprocessing/history, and report Indy and Loco separately.
observation_contract.coverage: All 22,091 endpoints are required in this finite exposed development pair. The 47-session original archive and 2-animal question are not delivered; programme/direct/viewer conditions do not add tasks.

primary.name: mean_axis_r2
primary.aggregation: Compute R-squared independently on all 22,091 x values and all 22,091 y values, then take their unweighted mean. A constant target axis leaves the primary undefined. Future multi-session extensions must macro-average complete session results within each animal.
primary.rationale: Preserves the actual implemented fixed-axis movement target and avoids silently replacing it with variance-weighted R-squared or source-result agreement.

secondary: Per-axis R-squared, MSE and MAE; negative R-squared is valid.
Eight descriptive consecutive 3,000-row clock blocks including the remainder; these do not create biological replicates.
Signed comparisons with all seven immutable reference methods on identical endpoints; no binary scientific-success threshold.
Proposed neural-dependence extension: preregister a source/calibration-fitted clock/target-history comparator and neural-shuffle control; not implemented by the seven current references.

comparators.name: zero_velocity, source_mean_velocity, calibration_mean_velocity
comparators.inputs: No assessment neural features; source or permitted calibration labels for corresponding means.
comparators.procedure: Three existing immutable non-neural prediction references; compare signed R-squared, MSE and MAE differences on all rows.

comparators.name: source_only_ridge and source_only_ridge_plus_calibration_mean_residual
comparators.inputs: Source labeled 10-bin count histories; latter additionally uses permitted calibration residual mean.
comparators.procedure: Existing fixed source-trained reference family; preserve source support and all stored comparisons without selecting a favorable reference after assessment.

comparators.name: calibration_only_ridge and balanced_pooled_ridge
comparators.inputs: Permitted labeled calibration only, or balanced source plus calibration count histories.
comparators.procedure: Existing immutable references; any adaptive-versus-frozen claim requires matched preparation, labels and compute beyond these file-score comparisons.

nuisance_controls: Keep electrode ordering and packet x/y convention fixed; do not substitute per-day sorted-neuron identities.
Fit scaling, hyperparameters and calibration policies using only source/calibration data; record target-day calibration duration and prior checkpoint exposure.
Separate trailing-bin batch reconstruction from causal prediction: full assessment access is allowed here and cannot attest past-only processing.
NEURAL-023 public assessment counts are NEURAL-024 private future targets; forbid combined mounts when evaluating 024 and retain prior-exposure disclosure.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report the complete single-pair estimate and descriptive clock-block variability. Time points and 96 electrodes are correlated nested observations, not replicates; do not use them for macaque-population confidence. A broader predeclared study should report each animal and paired session effects with temporal block resampling within session.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all IDs once, exact array schema and finite velocities before target access. Missing/duplicate/nonfinite/malformed submissions receive explicit invalid status and null score; unsupported finite arithmetic receives null primary score, never clipped improvement or favorable-prefix scoring. Independent arithmetic disagreement is an operator error.

implementation.scorer_target: external_score.py loads exact operator-provided assessment targets and seven saved reference metrics after complete public submission validation; score_core.py measures genuine measured velocity predictions with ID-aligned mean-axis R-squared. It neither runs candidate code nor verifies how predictions were produced.
implementation.delivered_scope: Published executable external-artifact grading source plus four pinned numerical helpers; complete 22,091-row public schema and fixed asset hashes. Historical manifest records file/program software qualification for this one exposed pair, but its original authoring paths are absent and are not the portable companion entrypoint.

No delivered direct observation transport, typed viewer, or per-case tool-assistance controller.
